about: History findings outside the known classes that a person or agent opened, read and classified. scan-history.js treats a (path, rule) pair listed here as reviewed. Listing something here is a claim that the value was looked at, so say what it is.

reviewed.finding: Synthetic sample in a redaction test: the platform-id prefix followed by the digits 1234567890. It sits in a list next to an example.com address and a dummy bearer token. Not a real account.
